label: Cause of the received totality: collective versus distributive
resolution: TOTALITY_CAUSE_1 (a95ed85b) is the collective reading: a primitive cause of the esse of all received actual bearers taken together, constrained only by premises A and B; its Lean sense declaration is premise A, the first constraint on the parameter, not a definitional equation. TOTALITY_CAUSE_2 (3770b94d) is the distributive reading: a distinct actual cause of some received bearer, a defined predicate. The registered premises A (05b15c98) and B (6c0282c0) and the derivation commonOfAggregate take TOTALITY_CAUSE_1. Control 2 of 7b9bac8e instantiates the same premise forms with TOTALITY_CAUSE_2 only as a comparison. Because sense 1 is a parameter constrained by A, not a type of its own, the split is recorded here rather than enforced by the type checker. The Hume-Edwards dispute is about which reading a complete totality of received being calls for: it grants that such a totality is caused in TOTALITY_CAUSE_2 and denies it in TOTALITY_CAUSE_1. No argument passes between the senses; control 2 shows that TOTALITY_CAUSE_2 satisfies A and fails B in the regress interpretation, and that no predicate satisfies both there. Because the parameter is constrained only by A and B, some predicate satisfies both exactly when, if anything is received, one actual bearer causes every received bearer's esse; so under either reading the substantive claim is that joint one, and a reading only shifts which premise carries it (TOTALITY_CAUSE_1: A; TOTALITY_CAUSE_2: B).
